newsitem.title: USA: Bank of Commerce still wants Fallbrook.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Commerce still wants Fallbrook.

text.p: Bank of Commerce reiterated on Monday it is still interested in a merger with Fallbrook National Bank.

Bank of Commerce said in a statement certain Fallbrook National shareholders have continued to contact Bank of Commerce expressing support for a merger. A number of Fallbrook National shareholders who had originally supported their directors' position have now informed Bank of Commerce of their desire to support a merger, the bank said. The bank also said professional investors supporting a merger of the two banks have also increased their holding in Fallbrook National.
"If investors in favor of a merger continue to acquire FNB shares, at some point we believe the FNB board may come to the negotiating table," Chairman, President and Chief Executive Peter Davis said.
Bank of Commerce's bid to acquire Fallbrook National in March was rejected.
